newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-FIORENTINA'S AMORUSO JOINS GLASGOW RANGERS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FIORENTINA'S AMORUSO JOINS GLASGOW RANGERS.

text.p: Fiorentina defender Lorenzo Amoruso has joined Scottish champions Glasgow Rangers on a four-year contract, his Italian club said on Friday.
A Fiorentina statement signed by general manager Giancarlo Antognoni said that the 26-year-old was leaving.
The deal, with an option on a fifth year, has been reported to be worth around $6 million, with the player set to receive $900,000 a year.
Amoruso, signed from Bari two years ago, has played 89 games in serie A and scored eight goals. His last game in Italy will be against Sampdoria on Sunday.
Italian newspapers have reported that Fiorentina are keen to sell certain players in order to offer unsettled Argentine striker Gabriel Batistuta a better financial package.
The Amoruso deal was the most lucrative the club had lined up and Batistuta was quoted as saying in Thursday's Gazzetta dello Sport that he was happy about the move.
"It's good for him and for Fiorentina who will bank a sum of around 10 billion lire ($6 million)," he said.
"The club has done well to sell him and Amoruso has done well to accept the Scottish club's offer."
Batistuta, who has been courted by Inter and Manchester United in England, said he did not know where his future lay but he was happy in Florence.
"There is still a lot I want to win, either with Fiorentina or with another club," he said.
